{{Clint Eastwood series}}
[[Clint Eastwood]] has had numerous casual and serious relationships of varying length and intensity over his life, many of which overlapped. He has eight known children by six women,<ref name=Wallace>{{cite web|last=Wallace|first=Debra|date=July 4, 2026|title=Meet Clint Eastwood's Kids! See the Acting Legend's 8 Children and Their Mothers|url=https://parade.com/1261389/debrawallace/clint-eastwood-children|website=Parade}}</ref><ref name=Dupre>{{cite web|last=Dupre|first=Elyse|date=July 24, 2024|url=https://www.eonline.com/news/1405341/a-guide-to-clint-eastwoods-sprawling-family|title=A Guide to Clint Eastwood's Sprawling Family|publisher=E! Online}}</ref> only half of whom were contemporaneously acknowledged. Eastwood refuses to confirm his exact number of offspring,<ref name=Playboy>{{cite web|url=http://www.playboy.com/articles/clint-eastwood-1997-playboy%20interview/index.html|title=Clint Eastwood - Interview - Western Movie Star|date=March 1997|first=Bernard|last=Weinraub|work=Playboy|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100624225509/http://www.playboy.com/articles/clint-eastwood-1997-playboy%20interview/index.html|archive-date=June 24, 2010|url-status=dead}}</ref> and there have been wide discrepancies in the media regarding the number. His biographer, [[Patrick McGilligan (biographer)|Patrick McGilligan]], has stated on camera that Eastwood's total number of children is indeterminate and that "one was when he was still in high school."<ref name=auto>{{cite interview|series=''Les grands reportages''|title=L'album secret de Clint Eastwood|publisher=Chérie 25|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Y6YIGhaaKTo|date=2012|time=50:06|via=YouTube}}</ref>

Eastwood's first marriage was to manufacturing secretary-turned-fitness instructor Margaret Neville Johnson in December 1953, having met her on a [[blind date]] the previous May. During the courtship, he had an affair that resulted in his daughter Laurie (born 1954), who was [[adopted]] by Clyde and Helen Warren of Seattle. While the identity of Laurie's biological mother is not public record, McGilligan said the mother belonged to a theatre group Eastwood participated in.{{sfn|McGilligan|2002|pages=54–55}} Eastwood continued having affairs while married to Johnson, including a 1959 to 1973 liaison with stuntwoman Roxanne Tunis that produced a daughter, Kimber (born 1964). Tunis and Eastwood would keep up a "healthy relationship" until her death in 2023.<ref name=Gelhoren>{{cite web|last=Gelhoren|first=Giovana|date=August 10, 2023|url=https://www.sheknows.com/entertainment/articles/2824648/clint-eastwood-longtime-mistress-mourning|title=Clint Eastwood's Reaction to His Former Mistress' Death Shows How Strong Their Connection Was|website=SheKnows}}</ref>

Johnson tolerated the [[open marriage]] with Eastwood, and eventually they had two children, [[Kyle Eastwood|Kyle]] (born 1968) and [[Alison Eastwood|Alison]] (born 1972). In 1975, Eastwood and married actress-director [[Sondra Locke]] began living together; she had been in a [[marriage of convenience]] since 1967 with [[Gordon Anderson (sculptor)|Gordon Leigh Anderson]], a gay sculptor. Locke claimed that Eastwood sang "She made me monogamous" to her and confided he had "never been in love before."<ref>{{cite book|last=Radner|first=Hilary|title=The New Woman's Film: Femme-centric Movies for Smart Chicks|year=2017|publisher=Taylor & Francis|isbn=9781317286479|page=60}}</ref> Nine years into their cohabitation, Eastwood officially divorced Johnson; Locke, however, would remain married to Anderson until her death in 2018. According to Bill Brown, publisher of the ''[[Carmel Pine Cone]]'', Eastwood considered Locke the love of his life,<ref name=Slaughter>{{cite news|last=Slaughter|first=Sylvia|title=An Affair of the Heart: Sondra vs. Clint in palimony suit|work=The Sunday Tennessean|date=May 28, 1989|url=https://www.newspapers.com/clip/49099067/the-tennessean|via=Newspapers.com|quote=Don Locke also believes that Clint Eastwood still truly loves his sister, but that he could no longer take her 'addiction' to Gordon. Bill Brown, publisher of ''The Pine Cone'' newspaper in Carmel and a golfing pal of Eastwood's, agrees: 'Clint told me not too long ago that Sondra was the love of his life.'}}</ref> yet he has never addressed her death.

In an unpublicized affair, Eastwood sired two legally fatherless children, [[Scott Eastwood|Scott]] (born 1986) and Kathryn (born 1988) with Jacelyn Reeves, a flight attendant. When Locke and Eastwood separated in 1989, Locke filed a [[Palimony in the United States|palimony]] lawsuit and later sued for [[fraud]], reaching a settlement in both cases.

During the early-to-mid-1990s, Eastwood had a relationship with actress [[Frances Fisher]] that yielded a daughter, [[Francesca Eastwood|Francesca]] (born 1993). Eastwood was married for the second time in 1996 to news anchor [[Dina Ruiz]], who gave birth to their daughter Morgan that same year. Ruiz and Eastwood's marriage lasted until 2014. He has been seen with other women since then.

Eastwood's spokespeople, managers, and press agents have long denied any knowledge of his life.<ref name=Winship>{{cite web|last=Winship|first=George|date=August 19, 1993|url=https://www.newspapers.com/newspage/794354472|title=A starlet is born to Eastwood, Fisher|work=Record Searchlight|via=Newspapers.com|quote='We only represent him on his movies,' Virginia Boyer of Warner Bros. studio said Wednesday. Eastwood's longtime agent, Leonard Hirshan of the William Morris Agency, also denied any knowledge of the star's life.}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|last=Jones|first=Oliver|date=September 9, 2013|url=https://people.com/celebrity/clint-eastwood-dina-eastwoods-marriage-drama|title=Clint Eastwood & Dina Eastwood's Marriage Drama|work=People|quote=Eastwood's longtime manager, Leonard Hirshan, says he has no knowledge of his client's personal life.}}</ref> Eastwood dated restaurant hostess Christina Sandera from 2014 until Sandera's death due to [[arrhythmia]] on July 18, 2024,<ref name=Hayley>{{cite web|last=Santaflorentina|first=Hayley|date=July 24, 2024|url=https://www.eonline.com/news/1405330/clint-eastwoods-longtime-partner-christina-sanderas-cause-of-death-revealed|title=Clint Eastwood's Longtime Partner Christina Sandera's Cause of Death Revealed|publisher=E! Online}}</ref> though he did not utter a word in public about their alliance prior to announcing that she had died. By the fall of 2024, Eastwood was in a new relationship, though his partner has not been identified.<ref name=Duncan>{{cite web|last=Duncan-Smith|first=Nicole|title='He's Not Wasting Precious Time': 94-Year-Old Clint Eastwood Sparks Controversy After Finding New Love Months After the Sudden Death of His Ex|website=Atlanta Black Star|date=October 10, 2024|url=https://atlantablackstar.com/2024/10/10/clint-eastwood-new-love-months-after-longtime-ex-christina-sandera-passed-away}}</ref>

== Early sexual relationships ==

During an interview for his sole authorized biography, Eastwood told film historian [[Richard Schickel]] that he lost his virginity to a neighbor when he was 14 years old.{{sfn|Schickel|1996|page=34}} At age 19, Eastwood dated a schoolteacher in her 20s who stalked him and threatened to commit suicide after he broke up with her.<ref>{{cite news|title=For the love of Clint|first=Ginny|last=Dougary|date=April 25, 1998|work=The Sydney Morning Herald|url=https://www.newspapers.com/newspage/120657723|via=Newspapers.com}}</ref> Reflecting upon this relationship, Eastwood told ''[[Us Weekly]]'' in 1987: "There was just a little misinterpretation about how serious the whole thing was."<ref>{{cite magazine|first=Ric|last=Gentry|title=Clint Eastwood: The ''Us'' Interview|magazine=Us Weekly|date=January 26, 1987|volume=3|issue=42|page=19}}</ref>

Eastwood acknowledged to Schickel that his conquests during these years were "numerous,"{{sfn|Schickel|1996|page=39}} though none are named in the book, and despite his ever-expanding notoriety as a [[Lothario]], none of the actor's subsequent biographers have managed to produce the names of any pre-showbusiness girlfriends.<ref>{{cite web|title=A Man's Man and a Ladies' Man|first=Jonathan V.|last=Last|date=August 16, 2002|work=The Wall Street Journal|url=https://www.wsj.com/articles/SB1029453820462528555}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Best Lothario Films: Eight Movie Womanizers|first=Nick|last=Pinkerton|date=December 1, 2011|work=Miami New Times|url=https://www.miaminewtimes.com/arts-culture/best-lothario-films-eight-movie-womanizers-6385396}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=The good, bad and ugly of Clint Eastwood — a revealing biography|first=Anne|last=Billson|date=September 12, 2025|work=The Times|url=https://www.thetimes.com/culture/books/article/clint-eastwood-movies-shawn-levy-review-k96gffw7z}}</ref>

== Marriage to Margaret Johnson ==

=== First extramarital affairs and daughter placed for adoption ===
[[File:Laurie Murray.jpg|thumb|upright|Eastwood's daughter Laurie, whose mother has never been identified]]
In early spring 1953,{{sfn|Levy|2025|page=26}} Eastwood met Margaret Neville 'Maggie' Johnson, a secretary for auto parts suppliers Industria Americana, on a [[blind date]] in the San Francisco area.<ref>{{cite book|last=Munn|first=Michael|title=Clint Eastwood: Hollywood's Loner|publisher=Robson|year=1992|isbn=9780860517900|page=18}}</ref>{{efn|Johnson was often described as a "model," but no evidence of her alleged modeling career has come to light, and a 1959 press release explicitly refers to her as a nonprofessional.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.newspapers.com/newspage/300129740|title=TV Mailbag|work=The Miami News|via=Newspapers.com|date=November 20, 1959|quote=Clint is 29. He is married to a nonprofessional, the former Maggie Johnson.}}</ref> As of 1990 she taught aerobics classes.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.newspapers.com/newspage/808601245|title=The Lovechild|first1=Paul|last1=Scott|first2=Mike|last2=Kerrigan|work=Sunday Mirror|via=Newspapers.com|date=April 8, 1990}}</ref> Various reference books also haphazardly assert her occupation as "swimsuit designer."<ref>{{cite book|first=Victoria|last=Houseman|title=Made in Heaven: The Marriages and Children of Hollywood Stars|year=1991|publisher=Bonus Books|page=95|isbn=9780929387246}}</ref><ref name=Parish>{{cite book|first=James Robert|last=Parish|title=The Hollywood Book of Breakups|year=2006|publisher=John Wiley & Sons, Inc|isbn=9781630262082|pages=148–149}}</ref>}} Johnson was scheduled to graduate from [[University of California, Berkeley|U.C. Berkeley]] that June. In the meantime, Eastwood left for Seattle, where "to please a girl he dug, he joined a Little Theatre group."<ref>{{cite magazine|title=The Way They Were|first=Earl|last=Leaf|date=April 1974|magazine=Rona Barrett's Hollywood|volume=5|number=8|pages=26–29}}</ref> The unnamed young woman became pregnant by Eastwood and placed their child, a girl, for adoption.{{sfn|McGilligan|2002|page=500}} Daughter Laurie Murray (also known as Laurie Alison Warren; born February 11, 1954)<ref>{{cite web|last1=Agate|first1=Samantha|last2=Brunati|first2=Bryan|date=June 28, 2024|url=https://www.closerweekly.com/posts/clint-eastwoods-kids-meet-the-8-eastwood-children|title=Clint Eastwood Is Extremely Close With His Kids! Meet the ''Gran Torino'' Star's 8 Children|work=Closer|archive-date=July 27, 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240727082533/https://www.closerweekly.com/posts/clint-eastwoods-kids-meet-the-8-eastwood-children/}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.instagram.com/p/CLLL8YGg8DI|title=[Untitled post]|first=Lowell Thomas IV|last=Murray|publisher=Instagram|date=February 11, 2021|quote=It's my Mom's birthday....}}</ref> was adopted by Clyde Elwin Warren and the former Helen I. Smith.{{sfn|Levy|2025|page=349}}<ref name=murray>{{cite web|url=https://www.newspapers.com/newspage/736101415|title=Engagements|work=The News Tribune|via=Newspapers.com|date=July 1, 1979}}</ref> Her existence went entirely unremarked in the press until 2018, when she was publicly acknowledged as Eastwood's child for the first time at age 64.<ref>{{cite episode|url=https://www.insideedition.com/clint-eastwood-appears-public-his-secret-daughter-first-time-49254|title=Clint Eastwood Appears in Public With His Secret Daughter for the First Time|series=Inside Edition|network=ABC|airdate=December 14, 2018}}</ref><ref name=ElPaso>{{cite news|title=Revela Clint Eastwood tener hija secreta|date=December 16, 2018|work=El Paso Times|language=Spanish|url=https://www.newspapers.com/newspage/978577005|agency=Agencia Reforma|via=Newspapers.com}}</ref>{{efn|Laurie had been photographed with Eastwood many years before she identified herself to the media, accompanying him to the [[76th Academy Awards]] in 2004.{{sfn|Levy|2025|page=408}}<ref name=Hagag>{{cite web|title=The Many Women and Many Children of Clint Eastwood|url=https://www.heraldweekly.com/the-many-women-and-many-children-of-clint-eastwood|date=March 25, 2021|first=Ofek|last=Hagag|work=Herald Weekly|archive-date=June 15, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210615052957/https://www.heraldweekly.com/the-many-women-and-many-children-of-clint-eastwood|url-status=dead}}</ref> Nonetheless, she remains an [[open secret]] in absence of official confirmation from her father himself. premiere of ''The Mule'' as "a very public gesture,"<ref>{{cite web|title=The Story Of Clint Eastwood|url=https://tv.azpm.org/schedules/episode/267030|publisher=Arizona Public Media|date=May 9, 2022}}</ref> it did not get mainstream coverage, with ''People'' magazine repudiating her existence afterward.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://people.com/movies/who-is-noor-alfallah-clint-eastwood-mick-jagger|title=All About Mick Jagger's Ex, 23, Who Was Spotted at Dinner with Clint Eastwood, 88|date=January 30, 2019|first=Dave|last=Quinn|work=People}}</ref>}} According to her son Lowell Thomas Murray IV, Laurie's biological mother—whose identity is not publicly known—"never told Eastwood she was pregnant or spoke to him again."<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.yahoo.com/lifestyle/see-clint-eastwoods-grandson-whos-140142376.html|title=See Clint Eastwood's Grandson, Who's a Trainer & Reality TV Star|first=Lia|last=Beck|date=October 21, 2021|publisher=Yahoo Life|archive-date=December 28, web|title=Dirty Harry's Dirty Secret|first=Tom|last=Leonard|date=February 1, 2019|agency=PressReader|url=https://www.pressreader.com/uk/daily-mail/20190201/282200832154202}}</ref> On the contrary, biographer [[Patrick McGilligan (biographer)|Patrick McGilligan]] said that Eastwood had discussed the woman's pregnancy with family and friends, then "handed money over to the woman and left for L.A."{{sfn|McGilligan|2002|pages=54–55}}

Meanwhile, Johnson announced her engagement to Eastwood in October 1953.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.newspapers.com/article/oakland-tribune-marriage-of-johnson-ea/73543160|title=Alpha Delta Pi Sisters Told Of Betrothal|work=Oakland Tribune|via=Newspapers.com|date=October 28, 1953}}</ref> They married on December 19 at Oneonta Congregational Church in [[South Pasadena, California]], less than eight weeks before his unidentified Seattle girlfriend gave birth to Laurie.{{sfn|McGilligan|2002|pages=54–55}}<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.newspapers.com/article/south-pasadena-review-marriage-of-eastwo/149712479|title=[Untitled notice]|author=No byline|work=South Pasadena Review|via=Newspapers.com|date=January 28, 1954}}</ref> There is still no explanation for why Eastwood decided to marry Johnson when another woman was carrying his child at the time. Biographer [[Shawn Levy (writer)|Shawn Levy]] argues that Eastwood "sincerely believed" the woman had gotten an abortion,{{sfn|Levy|2025|page=350}} while McGilligan contends that Eastwood sometimes talked about the possibility he was the father of someone living in Seattle.{{sfn|McGilligan|2002|page=500}} Laurie would go on to work as an elementary grade school teacher in Washington's [[South Kitsap School District]],<ref name=murray/> and has steadfastly refused to speak about her mother, who reportedly did not want to be contacted when Laurie reached out to her.<ref>{{cite web|last=Brow|first=Jason|date=December 13, 2018|url=https://hollywoodlife.com/2018/12/13/clint-eastwood-love-child-laurie-murray|title=Clint Eastwood's Secret Love Child Daughter: How She Found Her Dad & He Welcomed Her To Family|website=Hollywood Life}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|first=Louise|last=Boyle|title=Revealed: The touching story of Clint Eastwood's secret daughter, 64, who was put up for adoption by her mother but who tracked down the Hollywood legend 30 years ago. Now they share vacations, weddings and a passion for golf|url=https://www.msn.com/en-us/entertainment/celebrity/revealed-the-touching-story-of-clint-eastwoods-secret-daughter-64-who-was-put-up-for-adoption-by-her-mother-but-who-tracked-down-the-hollywood-legend-30-years-ago-now-they-share-vacations-weddings-and-a-passion-for-golf/ar-BBQTswb|publisher=MSN Entertainment|date=December 13, 2018|archive-date=November 1, 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191101034413/https://www.msn.com/en-us/entertainment/celebrity/revealed-the-touching-story-of-clint-eastwoods-secret-daughter-64-who-was-put-up-for-adoption-by-her-mother-but-who-tracked-down-the-hollywood-legend-30-years-ago-now-they-share-vacations-weddings-and-a-passion-for-golf/ar-BBQTswb|url-status=dead}}</ref> Eastwood, for his part, has long spurned requests for clarification and will not converse with the media regarding Laurie.<ref name=ElPaso/><ref>{{cite journal|url=https://www.ejumpcut.org/archive/jc59.2019/Alpert-Mule/text.html|title=Clint Eastwood's ''The Mule'', an old man's tale|work=Jump Cut|first=Robert|last=Alpert|date=2019|number=59}}</ref>

Eastwood's inexplicable marriage to Johnson had further problems. "He thought they were too young, not well enough established," Schickel wrote, noting that Johnson, the primary breadwinner, "expected to marry after a courtship had proceeded for a certain length of time."{{sfn|Schickel|1996|page=64}} Actress [[Mamie Van Doren]] later reported she had an affair with Eastwood over the summer of 1955 while working on ''[[Star in the Dust]]'', a low-budget B-movie in which she starred and he played an uncredited bit role.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://people.com/archive/chatter-vol-25-no-21|title=Chatter|work=People|first=Michael|last=Neill|date=May 26, 1986|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180611020109/https://people.com/archive/chatter-vol-25-no-21|archive-date=June 11, 2018|url-status=dead}}</ref> In the fall of that year, Eastwood purportedly had a tryst with a pre-fame [[Jayne Mansfield]].{{sfn|McGilligan|2002|page=71}} He refers to this period of his life as "married bachelorhood."<ref name=Clinch>{{cite book|last=Clinch|first=Minty|title=Clint Eastwood: A Biography|publisher=Hodder & Stoughton|year=1994|isbn=9780450594397|pages=70, 76}}</ref>

In 1959 during the second season of ''[[Rawhide (TV series)|Rawhide]]'', Eastwood began a long-lasting affair (reportedly 14 years)<ref name=Yoo/> with dancer and  stuntwoman Roxanne Tunis. She was also married yet separated.{{efn|Tunis had married Jack Watson Scheck Jr. in 1956.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.newspapers.com/newspage/529737951|title=Front Page Social Stories Including Marriages and Engagements of Regional Young Women|work=The Scrantonian|via=Newspapers.com|date=August 26, 1956}}</ref> She divorced him in December 1984, a month after Eastwood's own divorce and 10 months after the birth of Tunis and Eastwood's grandson, Clinton Gaddie (now Clint McCartney).<ref name=Enquirer>{{cite news|title=Clint's Bombshell Secret – He Has Illegitimate Daughter & Grandson|first1=Mike|last1=Kerrigan|first2=Brian|last2=Williams|date=July 11, 1989|work=National Enquirer}}</ref><ref>Ancestry.com. [https://www.ancestry.com/inst/discoveries/PfRecord?collectionId=1141&recordId=1591302 ''California, U.S., Divorce Index, 1966-1984''] [database on-line]. Provo, UT, USA: Ancestry.com Operations Inc, 2007.</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.parade.com/celebrity/2008/12/clint-eastwood.html|title=Clint Eastwood at 78: Reckless Again|first=Gail|last=Sheehy|date=December 7, 2008|work=Parade|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121114101721/http://www.parade.com/celebrity/2008/12/clint-eastwood.html|archive-date=November 14, 2012|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://unicourt.com/case/ca-ven-in-the-matter-of-mccartney-197552|title=In the Matter of McCartney|date=August 8, 2019|publisher=UniCourt}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Legal Notices|newspaper=The Fillmore Gazette|date=February 9, 2017|url=http://www.fillmoregazette.com/legals/02092017}}</ref> Their daughter Kimber attended at least one school under the surname Scheck.<ref>{{cite book|url=https://www.classmates.com/yearbooks/Villa-Cabrini-Academy/86377?page=165|title=Cabrinian|author=Villa Cabrini Academy|year=1970|via=classmates.com|page=161|location=Burbank, CA}}</ref>}} Their relationship resulted in Eastwood's earliest legal child, daughter Kimber Eastwood (born Kimber Tunis; June 17, 1964).{{sfn|McGilligan|2002|page=139}} Kimber's existence was kept secret from the public until July 1989, when the ''[[National Enquirer]]'' broke the story.<ref name=Enquirer/> Her birth certificate does list Eastwood as the father, however.{{sfn|McGilligan|2002|page=139}}{{efn|The cover-up notwithstanding, Kimber's existence seems to have been acknowledged within Eastwood's immediate family, as evidenced by his father's 1970 ''[[Oakland Tribune]]'' obituary cryptically listing "four grandchildren"—a count that exceeds the sum of sister Jeanne's two daughters and Eastwood's sole child of record at that time.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://images.findagrave.com/photos/2023/292/118703926_9c0cae33-0b2a-40b7-b10c-de054884a0e4.jpeg|title=Clinton Eastwood Dies; Star's Father|work=Oakland Tribune|via=FindAGrave|date=July 22, 1970}}</ref>}}

Biographer Marc Eliot wrote that Eastwood's wife Johnson may not have known about the baby at the time: "It is difficult to say for sure that she actually knew about the baby, although it would have been nearly impossible for her not to. Everyone on the set knew ... and it is simply too difficult to keep a secret like that when the mother and the illegitimate child live in the same small town, especially when that small town is Hollywood."{{sfn|Eliot|2009|page=69}} Tunis' friend Francesca Gregoli claimed Johnson was aware of Kimber's existence at all times and even met Roxanne in person when making an unannounced visit to the set of ''[[Breezy]]'' in 1972.<ref name=Thompson>{{cite book|last=Thompson|first=Douglas Henry|title=Clint Eastwood: Riding High|year=1992|publisher=Contemporary Books|isbn=9780809237678|pages=31, 39, 153}}</ref> Actress [[Barbara Eden]], a onetime ''Rawhide'' guest star and witness to the affair with Tunis, said Eastwood and Johnson "conducted a somewhat [[open marriage]]."<ref>{{cite book|last=Eden|first=Barbara|title=Jeannie Out of the Bottle|year=2011|publisher=Crown Archetype|isbn=9780307886958|page=110}}</ref> Eastwood himself considered it something to return to for a rest.<ref>[https://www.ebay.com/itm/325175890677 1972 magazine clipping] – via eBay.</ref> In an authorized 1971 profile in ''Screen Stars'', columnist Tim Chadwick wrote that Eastwood and Johnson "kept their distance from each other most of the time" and had "stayed together by staying apart!"<ref>{{cite magazine|first=Tim|last=Chadwick|title=We Don't Believe in 'Togetherness' — We've Stayed Together by Staying Apart!|date=July 1971|magazine=Screen Stars|volume=29|issue=7|quote=The only way Clint and Maggie Eastwood have managed to keep their marriage alive all these years is by having kept their distance from each other most of the time. They have stayed together by staying apart.}}</ref>

In 1992, Johnson granted a rare interview with biographer Douglas Thompson, talking in generalities about her ex-husband and his career, but refused comment when asked about Tunis.<ref name=Thompson/> Neither Tunis nor any of her nine siblings have ever spoken to the media.{{efn|Celebrity-adjacent in her own right, Tunis' sister Harriet has a son fathered by [[Stephen Stills]] of [[Crosby, Stills, Nash & Young]] fame, also out of wedlock, thus making Stills' son a maternal first cousin of Eastwood's daughter.<ref>{{cite book|last1=Roberts|first1=David|last2=Gedge|first2=David|title=Stephen Stills: Change Partners|year=2016|publisher=Red Planet Publishing Limited|isbn=9781787591011|page=238}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|first=Mitch|last=Michaels|url=https://yeahbabytunes.com/Rock_History/Entries/2011/12/22_Today_in_Rock_History.html|title=Today in Rock History|work=Yeah Baby Tunes|date=December 22, 2011}}</ref>}} However, sources close to the Tunis family agreed to be interviewed anonymously for McGilligan's book in the late 1990s. According to them, Eastwood "wanted to have a baby with his mistress. [He] would often stroke Tunis' tummy and ask, 'How's my little Rowdy coming?' When she became pregnant, Clint was ecstatic."{{sfn|McGilligan|2002|page=139}} This directly contradicts the earlier Schickel biography of 1996, which spun the tale that Eastwood didn't even realize Tunis was pregnant until after Kimber had been born.{{sfn|Schickel|1996|page=128}}

Tunis bought property in [[Deschutes River Woods, Oregon]] following the dissolution of their affair.<ref>{{cite web|title=News of record|date=April 23, 1976|work=The Bulletin|url=https://www.newspapers.com/newspage/1173483562|via=Newspapers.com}}</ref> Eastwood was pleased that she chose to leave Los Angeles, where news of their love child might get out.<ref name=Enquirer/> Over the years he occasionally gave Tunis work as an unbilled extra in his films; her casting in ''[[Hang 'Em High]]'' actually appeared in print.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.newspapers.com/newspage/1113520332|title=They're The Girls Of Old Fort Grant|work=The Evening Times-Globe|via=Newspapers.com|date=August 31, 1968}}</ref>

For her part, Kimber has answered media inquiries with candor. In 1989, amid revelations of her existence, she told the ''[[Sunday Mirror]]'': "Yes, Clint Eastwood is my father. I must speak to him about this. I am partly shocked and partly glad it is all out in the open."<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.newspapers.com/newspage/808610976|title=Dirty Harry's Secret Family|work=Sunday Mirror|first1=Annie|last1=Leask|first2=Mike|last2=Kerrigan|via=Newspapers.com|date=July 2, 1989}}</ref> Following this confirmation, Kimber shared in an interview with ''[[Star (magazine)|Star]]'' that "Mom called him because she's expecting a check. He began screaming and yelling into the phone. He's so upset because he's guilty."<ref>{{cite magazine|first=Kate|last=Caldwell|title=Clint Eastwood Disowns Love Child He's Kept Secret for 25 Years|date=May 6, 1990|url=https://www.newspapers.com/newspage/1279601595|work=The San Antonio Star|via=Newspapers.com}}</ref> In 1990, she told the ''[[Manchester Evening News]]'': "I'm cut off completely. He's furious with me. He's disowned me and his grandson."<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.newspapers.com/newspage/936501645|title=Dumped by dad Clint|work=Manchester Evening News|via=Newspapers.com|date=May 5, 1990}}</ref> Later that year, Eastwood refused to attend his daughter's wedding to Denver businessman Doug McCartney, so she was given away by an uncle instead.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.newspapers.com/newspage/808646110|title=Cold-heart Clint|first=Mike|last=Kerrigan|work=Sunday Mirror|via=Newspapers.com|date=June 10, 1990}}</ref> Throughout the tabloid hubbub Eastwood maintained complete silence; as a result, major publications like ''[[People (magazine)|People]]'' magazine still denied Kimber's existence as late as 1993.<ref>{{cite web|last=McFarland|first=Sabrina|date=August 30, 1993|url=https://people.com/people/archive/article/0,,20106160,00.html|title=Passages|work=People|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090604065756/https://people.com/people/archive/article/0,,20106160,00.html|archive-date=June 4, 2009}}</ref>{{efn|Moreover, when Tunis' maternal nephew (and Kimber's first cousin), Craig Gronenthal, was murdered in 1998, the ''[[Los Angeles Times]]'' repeatedly omitted any reference whatever to Eastwood or Stills.<ref>{{cite web|title=Police Search for Motive in Card Dealer's Slaying|first=Scott|last=Hadly|date=April 17, 1998|work=Los Angeles Times|url=https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-1998-apr-17-me-40172-story.html}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Co-Worker Charged in Club Slaying|first1=Lisa|last1=Fernandez|first2=Holly J.|last2=Wolcott|date=April 19, 1998|work=Los Angeles Times|url=https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-1998-apr-19-me-40904-story.html}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Card Dealer to Stand Trial in Slaying of Fellow Worker|first=Hilary E.|last=MacGregor|date=July 14, 1998|work=Los Angeles Times|url=https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-1998-jul-14-me-3597-story.html}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Man Pleads Guilty in Killing at Card Club|first=Tracy|last=Wilson|date=September 1, 1998|work=Los Angeles Times|url=https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-1998-sep-01-me-18412-story.html}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Card Dealer Is Sentenced in Killing at Club|first=Tracy|last=Wilson|date=September 30, 1998|work=Los Angeles Times|url=https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-1998-sep-30-me-27743-story.html}}</ref>}}

Roxanne Tunis died after a brief illness on June 23, 2023, at the age of 93.<ref name=obit/> Eastwood was devastated by the loss, their daughter reported.<ref name=radar>{{cite web|url=https://radaronline.com/p/clint-eastwoods-mistress-dies-mother-of-dirty-harrys-illegitimate-daughter-kimber-passes-away-at-age-93-pair-had-torrid-14-year-affair|title=Clint Eastwood's Mistress and Mother of His Daughter Kimber Passes Away at Age 93; Pair Had Torrid 14-Year Affair|work=Radar Online|last=Montero|first=Douglas|date=August 7, 2023}}</ref> Tunis has been described posthumously as "one of Clint's true loves."<ref name=Gelhoren/> A family intimate told [[Radar Online]]: "Roxanne worshipped the ground he walked on. She didn't give a damn about the fact that Clint was a star. She was never impressed with all the money and fame. All she ever wanted was to have and to hold Clint Eastwood the man."<ref name=radar/> At any rate, Eastwood has never talked about Tunis at all.<ref>{{cite web|title=Life Full of Love: Clint Eastwood's Relationship History Is Full of Gorgeous Women|first=Michelle|last=Konopka Alonzo|date=May 24, 2026|work=The List|url=https://www.thelist.com/2178100/clint-eastwood-relationship-history-gorgeous-women|quote=Eastwood never talked about Tunis at all — not even when Tunis died, aged 93, in June 2023. Instead, a source told the ''Daily Mail'' that Eastwood was reportedly 'gutted' and 'more emotional than he ever expected.'}}</ref>

=== Other affairs and reconciliation ===

Ria Brown, the biographer of competitive swimmer Anita Lhoest, claims Lhoest terminated a pregnancy by Eastwood without consulting him at one point during their late 1950s to early 1960s affair.<ref>''Take Ten'' (The Life Story of Anita Lhoest) by Ria Brown; unpublished manuscript cited under Acknowledgements section of McGilligan biography.</ref>{{sfn|Levy|2025|page=72}} Restaurant critic [[Gael Greene]] described an affair with Eastwood that started when she was assigned to interview him on the set of 1970's ''[[Two Mules for Sister Sara]]''.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.contactmusic.net/clint-eastwood/news/food-critic-reveals-she-bedded-hunky-clint_10_02_2006|title=Food Critic Reveals She Bedded Hunky Clint|date=February 10, 2006|agency=WENN|publisher=contactmusic.net|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170110160814/http://www.contactmusic.net/clint-eastwood/news/food-critic-reveals-she-bedded-hunky-clint_10_02_2006|archive-date=January 10, 2017|url-status=dead}}</ref> A fling with French model Cathy Reghin around the same time was one of his few extramarital involvements to receive press coverage of any kind during the fact.{{sfn|Levy|2025|page=128}} Another French model, Danielle Cotet, claimed a two-year relationship with Eastwood and got a [[Walk-on (actor)|walk-on]] role in ''[[Paint Your Wagon (film)|Paint Your Wagon]]'',<ref>{{cite book|last=McGee|first=Garry|title=Jean Seberg — Breathless|publisher=BearManor Media|year=2008|isbn=9781593931278|page=168}}</ref> unbeknownst to the film's lead actress [[Jean Seberg]], with whom Eastwood began an on-set dalliance that lasted about five months and ended with him [[Ghosting (behavior)|ghosting]] her.<ref>{{cite book|last=Richards|first=David|title=Played Out: The Jean Seberg Story|publisher=Berkley Books|year=1981|isbn=9780425063149|page=192}}</ref> During his tenure on ''Rawhide'', Eastwood dated professional boxer LaVonne 'Snow White' Ludian, remaining friends with her long afterward.<ref name=Cammalleri>[https://www.imdb.com/title/tt28405986 ''Right to Fight''] (2023, dir. Georgina Cammalleri). Sky Documentaries.</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.womenboxing.com/news040804eastwoodludian.htm|title=Women's Boxing NOT new to Clint Eastwood!|date=April 8, 2004|first=Sue TL|last=Fox|publisher=Women Boxing Archive Network}}</ref>{{efn|Ludian is believed to have been the inspiration for Eastwood's Oscar-winning blockbuster ''[[Million Dollar Baby]]''. In 2023, over half a century after their affair ended, Ludian felt let down when Eastwood ignored interview requests for ''Right to Fight'', a documentary about the pioneers of women's boxing, in which she was profiled.<ref name=Cammalleri/> Subsequently, the [[International Women's Boxing Hall of Fame]] called Eastwood out for not acknowledging Ludian.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.facebook.com/groups/womensboxing/posts/24567919049463125|first=Sue TL|last=Fox|title=[Untitled post]|publisher=Facebook|date=June 24, 2025}}</ref>}} According to McGilligan, Eliot and Levy, Eastwood had many other affairs, including with ''Hang 'Em High'' co-stars [[Inger Stevens]]{{sfn|McGilligan|2002|page=163}} and [[Arlene Golonka]],{{sfn|Eliot|2009|page=94}} ''[[The Beguiled (1971 film)|The Beguiled]]'' co-star [[Jo Ann Harris]],{{sfn|Levy|2025|page=128}} actresses [[Jill Banner]],<ref name=Clinch/> [[Catherine Deneuve]],<ref name=Hagag/> [[Susan St. James]]<ref name=Thompson/> and [[Reiko Oshida]],{{sfn|McGilligan|2002|page=147}} columnist Bridget Byrne,{{sfn|McGilligan|2002|page=228}} socialite Joan Lundberg Hitchcock{{sfn|McGilligan|2002|page=271}} and jazz singer [[Keely Smith]]{{sfn|Levy|2025|page=128}} while married to Johnson, who, after a [[trial separation]] and a lingering bout of [[hepatitis]] during the mid-1960s, expressed desire to reconcile and start a family.{{sfn|McGilligan|2002|page=228}} They had two children together: [[Kyle Eastwood]] (born May 19, 1968) and [[Alison Eastwood]] (born May 22, 1972).{{sfn|Schickel|1996|page=286}}{{sfn|McGilligan|2002|page=484}}

With few exceptions, Eastwood avoided becoming entangled with women who might attract publicity, instead preferring low-profile paramours. Restaurant manager Paul E. Lippman, who co-founded the Hog's Breath Inn with Eastwood in 1972, said: {{blockquote|I had to terminate three pretty good waitresses in the first few months of operation; not because they went to bed with Clint Eastwood, but because they either talked about it all over the premises, or came in the next day acting like they owned the place.  A fourth waitress continued sleeping with him on a regular basis, but I didn’t have to fire her because she didn’t talk about it; she wanted to be an actress. And she got a speaking part in ''[[The Eiger Sanction (film)|The Eiger Sanction]]'' while still a waitress!{{sfn|McGilligan|2002|page=202}}}}

Eastwood was the subject of a [[blind item]] linking him romantically with pro-communist activist [[Angela Davis]], although both parties have chosen not to address this.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.crazydaysandnights.net/2017/03/today-blind-items-secret-condo.html|title=Today's Blind Items - The Secret Condo|website=Crazy Days and Nights|date=March 6, 2017}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.lipstickalley.com/threads/ummmm-this-blind-item-about-clint-eastwood-and-angela-davis-tho.2102100|title=Ummmm, This Blind Item About Clint Eastwood and Angela Davis, tho|website=Lipstick Alley|date=January 22, 2019}}</ref> ''[[Thunderbolt and Lightfoot]]'' bit player [[June Fairchild]] wrote of an amorous encounter with Eastwood in her memoir, ''Catch a Fallen Star''.<ref>{{cite book|last=Fairchild|first=June|editor-last1=Barr|editor-first1=Sam|editor-last2=Griebenow|editor-first2=Gail|title=Catch a Fallen Star|year=2014|url=http://www.barrsam.com/JuneFairchildBook/JuneFairchildBook.html|publisher=O’Reilly Media, Inc|chapter=Clint and I in the Hotel Room!!!}}</ref> When Fairchild became homeless in 2007, Eastwood wanted to get in touch with her to give her a helping hand.<ref>{{cite news|first=Kimberley|last=Dadds|title=Eastwood helps troubled '70s co-star|date=August 28, 2007|url=https://www.digitalspy.com/showbiz/a74227/eastwood-helps-troubled-70s-co-star|work=Digital Spy}}</ref>

== Relationship with Sondra Locke ==
[[File:Sondra Locke & Clint Eastwood 1975.jpg|thumb|left|Locke and Eastwood in 1975, during filming of ''The Outlaw Josey Wales'']]

In 1972, Eastwood met married actress (later director) [[Sondra Locke]] at a meeting set up by mutual friend [[Jo Heims]] on the [[Universal Studios Lot]].<ref>{{cite book|last=O'Brien|first=Daniel|title=Clint Eastwood: Film-Maker|publisher=B. T. Batsford|year=1996|isbn=9780713478396|page=119}}</ref>{{efn|It is commonly misreported that Locke "auditioned" for ''Breezy''. In actual fact, she was rejected on the spot for being too old.{{sfn|Schickel|1996|page=295}}<ref>{{cite episode|title=Clint Eastwood and Sondra Locke|series=Hollywood Couples|network=Multicom Entertainment Group|season=2|number=4|date=2001}}</ref>}} Locke's lifestyle was congruent to his, as she had married for societal purposes while conducting a succession of affairs that were withheld from public view.{{sfn|Henderson|2020|page=325}} Like Eastwood, she maintained the fiction of being happily married when she needed to conceal other alliances.<ref>{{cite book|last=Kessler|first=Judy|title=Inside People|publisher=Villard Books|year=1994|isbn=9780679421863|page=64}}</ref>{{efn|Not all of Locke's extramarital affairs had been kept secret. She and [[Bo Hopkins]], her co-star in the TV movie ''Gondola'', were a public couple, appearing together in five episodes of the game show ''[[Tattletales]]'' that aired right before she left him for Eastwood—all while remaining married to Anderson.<ref>These shows were taped in the summer of 1975 and aired early that fall:
* {{cite episode|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-FfSBFi1qNU|title=Sondra & Bo|series=Tattletales|season=3|number=21|network=CBS}}
* {{cite episode|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gJ994n3BbKM|title=Sondra & Bo|series=Tattletales|season=3|number=22|network=CBS}}
* {{cite episode|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yzNifrXdNEQ|title=Sondra & Bo|series=Tattletales|season=3|number=23|network=CBS}}
* {{cite episode|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zqXlCx0ODIw|title=Sondra & Bo|series=Tattletales|season=3|number=24|network=CBS}}
* {{cite episode|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yQrOGWR5eaE|title=Sondra & Bo|series=Tattletales|season=3|number=25|network=CBS}}</ref><ref name=msn>{{cite web|title=For most of her career, Sondra Locke worked with her partner Clint Eastwood. When they broke up, she not only got breast cancer—she got scammed.|url=https://www.msn.com/en-us/health/other/ss-AA20WpAw|date=April 14, 2026|first=Byron|last=Fast|work=TheShot|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260429094107/https://www.msn.com/en-us/health/other/ss-AA20WpAw|archive-date=April 29, 2026|url-status=dead}}</ref>}} The two began living together during the production of ''[[The Outlaw Josey Wales]]'' in [[Page, Arizona]] in October 1975,{{sfn|McGilligan|2002|page=262}}{{sfn|Levy|2025|page=210}} by which time, according to Locke, "He had told me that there was no real relationship left between him and Maggie."{{sfn|Locke|1997|page=141}} Locke wrote in her autobiography, "Clint seemed astonished at his need for me, even admitting that he'd never been faithful to one woman — because he'd 'never been in love before,' he confided. He even made up a song about it: 'She made me monogamous'. That flattered and delighted me. I would never doubt his faithfulness and his love for me."{{sfn|Locke|1997|page=145}}

[[File:Eastwood Locke The Gauntlet 1977.jpg|thumb|With Locke in ''The Gauntlet'' (1977)]]

After ''Josey'' wrapped, Locke moved into the [[Sherman Oaks]] house Eastwood had once shared with Johnson (who by then lived full-time in [[Pebble Beach]]),<ref name=Parish/> but felt uncomfortable there because "psychologically it would always be Maggie's," and insisted they relocate.{{sfn|Locke|1997|page=173}} The couple moved to [[Bel Air, Los Angeles|Bel-Air]] in a [[fixer-upper]] that took three years to remodel.{{sfn|Henderson|2020|page=337}} In the interim they shuttled between homes in [[Tiburon, California]] and [[Sun Valley, Idaho]], as well as the [[Rising River Ranch]] which Eastwood bought from [[Bing Crosby]]'s estate.{{sfn|Locke|1997|page=164}}<ref>{{cite web|url=http://imn.stparchive.com/Archive/IMN/IMN11301978P01.php|title=Eastwood buys ranch|work=Inter Mountain News|via=SmallTownPapers, Inc.|date=November 30, 1978}}</ref> Locke underwent two abortions and a [[tubal ligation]] during the late 1970s.{{sfn|Locke|1997|page=171}} She was quite reluctant to get the second abortion—at 35, she was almost a decade above the median age of American married women receiving this procedure—and mused how she "couldn't help but think that that baby, with both Clint's and my best qualities, would be extraordinary."{{sfn|Locke|1997|page=171}}<ref>{{cite journal|title=Induced Terminations of Pregnancy: Reporting States, 1979|journal=Monthly Vital Statistics Report|publisher=National Center for Health Statistics|first=Drusilla|last=Burnham|volume=31|number=7|page=4|date=October 25, 1982}}</ref>{{efn|In a 1969 [[Dick Kleiner]] interview, Locke said: "I'd feel sorry for any child that had me for a mother."<ref>{{cite web|first=Dick|last=Kleiner|url=https://www.newspapers.com/newspage/39142654|title=Reaction Varied To ''Run Shadow Run'' Film|work=Panama City News|via=Newspapers.com|date=July 31, 1969}}</ref> This is consistent with Eastwood's account that Locke repeatedly confided she never wanted to have children.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.newspapers.com/newspage/374397328|title=Sandra Locke bitter, shocked about split with Eastwood|work=Hartford Courant|first=Claudia|last=Puig|via=Newspapers.com|date=May 18, 1989}}</ref>}} Johnson made no secret of her dislike for Locke, even though the two women never met. "Maggie placed severe rules on my relationship with the kids [...] After she learned that Clint had taken me onto her property to show me a baby deer that had just been born there, she laid down a rule that I was never to be allowed there again. I was not even allowed to phone the Pebble Beach house."{{sfn|Locke|1997|page=165}}

=== Divorce from Johnson ===

In 1978, Johnson retained an attorney to file for [[legal separation]] from Eastwood.{{sfn|Henderson|2020|page=334}} Early that year she had finally accepted the fact that Locke "was not like any of his affairs of their past."{{sfn|Locke|1997|page=152}} The legal separation came into effect by a notarized agreement in January 1979.<ref>{{cite news|title=Every which way but divorce|first=Marilyn|last=Beck|date=September 17, 1979|work=The Idaho Statesman|url=https://www.newspapers.com/newspage/913798811|via=Newspapers.com}}</ref> Divorce papers, however, would not be filed until May 18, 1984.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.newspapers.com/newspage/33409359|title=Actor sued for divorce|agency=United Press International|work=Ukiah Daily Journal|via=Newspapers.com|date=May 20, 1984}}</ref> The divorce was finalized on November 19,<ref>Ancestry.com. [https://www.ancestry.com/inst/discoveries/PfRecord?collectionId=1141&recordId=1515526 ''California, U.S., Divorce Index, 1966-1984''] [database on-line]. Provo, UT, USA: Ancestry.com Operations Inc, 2007.</ref> with Johnson receiving a straight cash payment said to be between $20 and $25 million.{{sfn|Levy|2025|page=265}} She died on October 4, 2026, aged 94.<ref>{{cite web|title=Clint Eastwood’s First Wife Dead at 94|url=https://parade.com/celebrities/clint-eastwoods-first-wife-dead-at-94|work=Parade|date=October 7, 2026|first=Kayla|last=Aldecoa}}</ref>

For her part, Locke never divorced [[Gordon Anderson (sculptor)|Gordon Anderson]], her lawful husband since 1967.<ref name=Dalton>{{cite news|first=Andrew|last=Dalton|title=Oscar-nominated actress Sondra Locke dies at 74|date=December 13, 2018|url=https://www.aol.com/entertainment/2018-12-14-sondra-locke-dies-at-74-23618233.html|publisher=AOL}}</ref>{{efn|Folklore describing Anderson as Locke's "childhood friend" has long been parroted by the press, though they grew up in different states and did not even meet until high school.<ref name=Gilbey>{{cite web|last=Gilbey|first=Ryan|date=December 14, 2018|url=https://www.theguardian.com/film/2018/dec/14/sondra-locke-obituary|title=Sondra Locke obituary|work=The Guardian}}</ref>{{sfn|Locke|1997|pages=18–20}}}} Anderson, a sculptor and former stage actor, was gay and resided with his boyfriend John McKee in a [[West Hollywood]] home purchased by Eastwood.<ref>{{cite web|title=The Year in Sex|date=February 1990|work=Playboy|url=https://www.playboy.com/magazine/articles/1990/02/the-year-in-sex|url-access=registration}}</ref> The Locke/Anderson union had always been a marriage of convenience only and, according to court testimony, was never consummated.<ref name=Gilbey/><ref>{{cite web|title=A Fond Farewell to Sondra Locke (1944 – 2018)|url=https://www.filmink.com.au/fond-farewell-sondra-locke-1944-2018|first=John|last=Harrison|date=December 16, 2018|website=FilmInk}}</ref> Locke said of the unorthodox arrangement: "I truly believed that Clint and I did not need papers to validate the commitments we had made to each other."{{sfn|Locke|1997|page=153}} Her husband Anderson kept such a low profile that, over time, reporters would either erroneously refer to their still-legal marriage in the past tense or altogether omit any reference to it.<ref>{{cite news|title=Sondra Locke keys into directing|first=Patricia|last=Lyons|date=September 26, 1986|work=The Ledger|url=https://news.google.com/newspapers?id=pGRNAAAAIBAJ&pg=6921%2C4419374|via=Google News Archive}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Sondra Locke soars sans Clint Eastwood|first=Vernon|last=Scott|date=October 27, 1986|work=The Bryan Times|url=https://news.google.com/newspapers?id=zcNPAAAAIBAJ&pg=5534%2C2359766|via=Google News Archive}}</ref>

Eastwood and Locke reteamed onscreen for ''[[The Gauntlet (film)|The Gauntlet]]'', ''[[Every Which Way but Loose (film)|Every Which Way but Loose]]'', ''[[Bronco Billy]]'', ''[[Any Which Way You Can]]'' and ''[[Sudden Impact]]''. According to former longtime associate Fritz Manes, Eastwood was devoted to her between 1976 and 1980 at the least, but discreetly kept up several "maintenance relationships" (such as with Tunis){{sfn|McGilligan|2002|page=353}} during that period. "I marveled at it," Manes said. "It was absolute total, blind love."{{sfn|McGilligan|2002|page=353}} According to Schickel, the relationship began to disintegrate when Locke chose to remain married to Anderson for tax purposes after Eastwood had divorced Johnson.{{sfn|Schickel|1996|page=408}} Locke said she would have been willing to divorce Anderson if Eastwood agreed to go to [[couples therapy]] with her, but he refused,{{sfn|Locke|1997|page=229}} despite bemoaning, "She's married to someone who doesn't work. So what does that do? That makes me the sole provider."<ref name=independent1>{{cite web|last=Young|first=Josh|date=May 4, 1997|url=https://www.independent.co.uk/arts-entertainment/the-good-the-bad-and-the-ugly-1259606.html|title=The Good, the Bad and the Ugly|work=The Independent}}</ref> Locke later counterclaimed that although Eastwood did pay for her husband's house, he "never spent one single penny on any support for Gordon. It was I who had always taken care of Gordon from my own earnings."{{sfn|Locke|1997|page=267}}

===Affairs with Jacelyn Reeves and others===
[[File:Jacelyn Reeves.jpg|thumb|Jacelyn Reeves bore two of Eastwood's children with no publicity whatsoever.]]
McGilligan claims Eastwood returned to his "habitual womanizing" in the early 1980s, becoming involved with story analyst Megan Rose,{{sfn|McGilligan|2002|page=353}} actresses [[Jamie Rose]]{{sfn|McGilligan|2002|page=364}} and Rebecca Perle<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ranker.com/list/clint-eastwood-loves-and-hookups/celebrityhookups|title=Clint Eastwood's Wives, Girlfriends, And Dating History|website=Ranker|access-date=November 6, 2024}}</ref> (both of whom appeared in ''[[Tightrope (film)|Tightrope]]''), [[James Brolin]]'s animal rights activist ex-wife Jane Agee (who had intermittent liaisons with Eastwood between the early 1960s and late 1980s, encompassing one abortion),{{sfn|Henderson|2020|page=336}} and Jacelyn Reeves, a stewardess he reputedly met at his restaurant in Carmel, the Hog's Breath Inn.{{sfn|Eliot|2009|page=226}} Amid all this, Eastwood sued the ''National Enquirer'' in 1982 over a story claiming he cheated on Locke with country singer [[Tanya Tucker]], who was 15 years younger than Locke.<ref>{{cite news|title=Eastwood suing Enquirer over Tanya Tucker report|agency=United Press International|date=May 6, 1982|work=The Evening News|url=https://www.newspapers.com/newspage/1091217372|via=Newspapers.com}}</ref>

February 2, 1988).{{sfn|Eliot|2009|page=6}} The birth certificates for both children read "father declined."{{sfn|Levy|2025|page=291}}<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.independent.co.uk/arts-entertainment/films/features/scott-eastwood-interview-how-clints-son-bounced-back-after-being-rejected-for-role-in-fathers-film-10314191.html|title=Scott Eastwood interview: How Clint's son bounced back after being rejected for role in ''American Sniper''|first=Tom|last=Teodorczuk|date=June 12, 2015|work=The Independent}}</ref> Eastwood's affair with Reeves was not reported anywhere until an [[Exposé (journalism)|exposé]] article was published in the ''Star'' tabloid in 1990.<ref name=Star>{{cite magazine|title=Clint Eastwood's Secret 4-Year Love Comes Out of Hiding|first1=Bob|last1=Smith|first2=Stephen|last2=Viens|date=March 4, 1990|url=https://www.newspapers.com/newspage/1281155793|work=The San Antonio Star|via=Newspapers.com}}</ref>{{efn|The ''Star'' exposé came about after paparazzo Vinnie Zuffante photographed Reeves with Eastwood during the 1990 [[AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am]].<ref name=Star/> Pictures from that event are misdated as 1987 on [[Getty Images]], and the error has been propagated into secondary citations.<ref name=Wallace/>}} It quoted Reeves as saying, "Some family members tell me to file a [[paternity suit]] against Clint, but I don't want to."<ref name=Star/> The children's existence continued to be ignored by mainstream news sources through the mid-2000s.<ref>The Reeves children are not included in the count, for example, at {{cite news|url=http://www.people.com/people/archive/article/0,,20143212,00.html|title=Passages|work=People|first=Jeremy|last=Helligar|date=January 13, 1997|quote=News anchor Dina Ruiz, 31, more than made husband Clint Eastwood's day when she gave birth to the couple's first child, an 8-lb. 4-oz. girl named Morgan, on Dec. 12 in Los Angeles. === Breakup with Locke ===

Eastwood's relationship with Locke (at the time unaware of his infidelities, by her own account){{sfn|McGilligan|2002|page=440}} ended acrimoniously in April 1989, and the post-breakup litigation dragged on for a decade. Locke filed a [[palimony]] lawsuit against him after he changed the locks on their home and moved her possessions into storage when she was at work filming her second directorial feature, ''[[Impulse (1990 film)|Impulse]]''.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://people.com/archive/cover-story-after-the-loving-counting-the-cost-vol-32-no-6|title=When Harry Left Sondra|date=August 7, 1989|work=People|first=Diana|last=Waggoner}}</ref> In court, Eastwood downplayed the intensity of their relationship, arguing that because Locke had been married to somebody else for its entire duration, she was not entitled to a payout.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.deseret.com/1990/11/6/18889941/clint-eastwood-60-is-a-good-age-for-the-relaxed-actor-br|title=Clint Eastwood: 60 Is a Good Age for the Relaxed Actor|date=November 6, 1990|work=Deseret News|first=Robert|last=Denerstein}}</ref> He referred to Locke as his "roommate" before quickly redescribing her as a "part-time roommate."{{sfn|Locke|1997|page=263}}{{sfn|Levy|2025|page=316}} Bill Brown, publisher of the ''[[Carmel Pine Cone]]'' newspaper and a golfing pal of Eastwood's, said despite the public antipathy, "Clint told me not too long ago that Sondra was the love of his life."<ref name=Slaughter/> Locke's estranged half-brother Donald told ''[[The Tennessean]]'' that Eastwood still truly loved her, but could no longer take her "addiction" to husband Gordon Anderson.<ref name=Slaughter/>

Anticipating that Eastwood was going to misrepresent the marriage, Locke asked Anderson to surrender all claims on any of her assets that as her legal spouse he was entitled to.<ref>{{cite book|author=Hadleigh, Boze|title=Celebrity Feuds! The Cattiest Rows, Spats, and Tiffs Ever Recorded|year=1999|publisher=Taylor Trade Publishing|isbn=9781461708582|page=27}}</ref> "In an extraordinary gesture of love and faith in me, Gordon signed away everything without hesitation."{{sfn|Locke|1997|page=252}} During the proceedings, an investigative journalist contacted Locke and informed her of Eastwood's other family. "I spoke with the nurse in the delivery room, and she confirmed that they are Clint's children. I'll send copies of the birth certificates to you and a photo of Jacelyn, if you want them," Locke quoted the informant.{{sfn|Locke|1997|page=270}} "My mind was still searching to get all his actions lined up. For at least the last four years, Clint had been living this double life, going between me and this other woman, and ''having children with her''. Two babies had been born during the last three years of our relationship, and they weren't mine."{{sfn|Locke|1997|page=270}}

== Casual dating ==

Immediately following his split from Locke, Eastwood dated [[Barbra Streisand]].<ref>{{cite web|title=What's this about Clint Eastwood falling for Barbra Streisand?|date=May 16, 1989|url=https://www.orlandosentinel.com/1989/05/16/whats-this-about-clint-eastwood-falling-for|work=Orlando Sentinel|quote=It's the talk of all Hollywood. Eastwood and Streisand are on the rebound – he from a 15-year relationship with actress-director Sondra Locke, she from a short but intense fling with Don Johnson. The result: Eastwood and Streisand are Tinseltown's most provocative couple of the moment.}}</ref>{{sfn|Schickel|1996|page=344}} Other companions during 1989 included ''[[White Hunter, Black Heart]]'' co-star [[Marisa Berenson]], Carmel mayor Jean Grace, actress [[Dani Crayne]] and model [[Barbara Minty]], widow of [[Steve McQueen]].<ref>{{cite web|last=Johnson|first=Richard|date=September 7, 1989|url=https://www.newspapers.com/newspage/132692834|title=Eastwood, Berenson sizzle|work=The Palm Beach Post|via=Newspapers.com}}</ref><ref>{{cite book|last1=Moser|first1=Margaret|last2=Bertin|first2=Michael|last3=Crawford|first3=Bill|title=Movie Stars Do the Dumbest Things|date=1999|publisher=St. Martin's Press|isbn=9781580631075|page=83}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://news.google.com/newspapers?id=0eVPAAAAIBAJ&pg=6377%2C6226884|title=TV Q&A|date=August 28, 1990|work=Ocala Star-Banner|via=Google News Archive}}</ref> The next year, amid brouhaha over their unconventional female-on-male rape scene in ''[[The Rookie (1990 film)|The Rookie]]'', Eastwood was rumored to be seeing co-star [[Sonia Braga]], which Braga initially denied,<ref name=Thompson/>{{efn|[[Donna Mills]], with whom Eastwood had a much-ballyhooed sex scene in ''[[Play Misty for Me]]'', also dismissed reportage of a real-life liaison.<ref>{{cite book|last=Plaza|first=Fuensanta|title=Clint Eastwood/Malpaso|year=1991|publisher=Ex Libris Pub|isbn=9780962948190}}</ref>}} but later conceded.<ref>{{cite web|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070622054356/http://www.diarioon.com.br/arquivo/4688/cadernos/viver-19359.htm|archive-date=June 22, 2007|url=https://www.diarioon.com.br/arquivo/4688/cadernos/viver-19359.htm|title=Amor sem idade|publisher=Diário OnLine|url-status=dead|language=Portuguese}}</ref>

Up until this point, Eastwood had gone to considerable effort to keep his personal life secret; now his entanglements were being contemporaneously chronicled in the press, with one headline reading: "Clint Eastwood is [[Promiscuity|playing the field]]".<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.newspapers.com/newspage/1185261008|title=Clint Eastwood is playing the field|first=Robin|last=Adams Sloan|work=The Bay City Times|via=Newspapers.com|date=October 25, 1990}}</ref> He pursued a romance with ''[[Pink Cadillac (film)|Pink Cadillac]]'' co-star [[Bernadette Peters]], but she would not entertain the idea unless he could fully commit himself.<ref>{{cite book|last=Smith|first=Paul|title=Clint Eastwood: A Cultural Production|year=1993|publisher=University of Minnesota Press|isbn=9780816619580|page=254}}</ref>

== Daughter with Frances Fisher ==

Eastwood's next major relationship was with actress [[Frances Fisher]], whom he met at a pre-production party for ''Pink Cadillac'' in October 1988.{{sfn|Schickel|1996|page=436}} The two quietly enjoyed a nonexclusive, intermittent affair for two years before going public with their romance in late 1990.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.newspapers.com/newspage/176415549|title=On the Soaps|first=Lynda|last=Hirsch|work=Florida Today|via=Newspapers.com|date=October 14, 1990}}</ref> By mid-1991, however, Eastwood was already cheating on her with an employee at the [[Warner Bros. Movie World]] theme park.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.goldcoastbulletin.com.au/news/gold-coast/clint-eastwoods-rumoured-affair-with-gold-coast-local-when-he-visited-for-movie-world-launch/news-story/2d3f43b425fc2b53eecbbf621cd7c79c|title=Eastwood's 'torrid affair' with local at Movie World launch|work=Gold Coast Bulletin|date=May 10, 2020}}</ref> Fisher retrospectively said of dating Eastwood: "I simply felt that this was it, the big one. I had no idea that every woman he meets probably feels as I did."<ref name=Barber>{{cite web|url=http://www.thefreelibrary.com/I+was+giving+birth,+scared+and+five+weeks+early,+and+Clint+was...-a061133868|title=I was giving birth, scared and five weeks early, and Clint was signing his autograph for a nurse!; The Woman Who Lived with Dirty Harry for Six Years Tells Why She Had to Leave Him|first=Richard|last=Barber|date=May 11, 1997|work=The Sunday People|via=The Free Library}}</ref> They co-starred in 1992's ''[[Unforgiven]]'', and had a daughter, [[Francesca Eastwood]] (born Francesca Fisher-Eastwood; August 7, 1993), on the anniversary of that film's release.{{sfn|Levy|2025|page=349}} The birth of Francesca marked the first time Eastwood was present for one of his children being born.{{sfn|McGilligan|2002|page=484}} Nevertheless, he made Fisher keep her pregnancy a secret until her last trimester, reasoning, "I don't want that kinda thing taking attention away from my Oscar race!"{{sfn|Locke|1997|page=316}} Further defying custom, they did not issue a statement announcing Francesca's birth—the news only came to light two weeks after the fact, when somebody at the [[Shasta County, California|Shasta County]] Clerk's Office alerted the media.<ref name=Winship/>

Despite being legally free to wed, the couple did not marry. Around a month before their daughter was born, according to McGilligan, Eastwood was confronted with the claims of a 39-year-old woman from [[Kent, Washington]] who had researched her adoption and ascertained that he was her biological father.{{sfn|McGilligan|2002|page=500}} Eastwood has never responded to the story.{{sfn|Eliot|2009|page=336}} An additional strain on the relationship came when Fisher found out—not through him—about yet another hidden brood with Jacelyn Reeves.<ref name=independent1/> Eastwood and Fisher ended their relationship in January 1995, after which Fisher said it took two years to complete what she called the grieving process for her shattered dreams.<ref name=Barber/><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-1995-09-15-ca-46085-story.html|title=How's Life After Clint? Look at Frances Fisher's Schedule|first=Laurie K.|last=Schenden|date=September 15, 1995|work=Los Angeles Times}}</ref> She also divulged that her breakup with Eastwood required [[mediation]].<ref name=Frances>{{cite web|url=https://www.facebook.com/frances.fisher.129/posts/10151208629741098|title=[Untitled post]|first=Frances|last=Fisher|publisher=Facebook|date=September 1, 2012}}</ref> Schickel attributed the split to political differences and Eastwood's disdain for Fisher's [[New Age]] beliefs.{{sfn|Schickel|1996|pages=486–487}}

In 2018, Francesca gave birth to a son named Titan Wraith.<ref>{{cite web|last=Merrett|first=Robyn|date=September 24, 2018|url=https://people.com/parents/francesca-eastwood-boyfriend-alexander-wraith-welcome-son-titan|title=Francesca Eastwood and Boyfriend Alexander Wraith Welcome Son Titan|work=People}}</ref> While Eastwood is a grandfather several times over, Titan is his first grandchild whose birth was announced.<ref>Eastwood's other grandchildren of record are:

== Marriage and divorce with Dina Ruiz==

[[File:Clint and Dina Eastwood.jpg|thumb|With then-wife [[Dina Eastwood|Dina]] in 2007]]

Before Fisher had moved out of Eastwood's house, he was reportedly already dating [[Dina Eastwood|Dina Ruiz]],<ref name=Yoo>{{cite web|url=http://www.people.com/people/archive/article/0,,20103280,00.html|title=Making His Day|date=April 15, 1996|first=Paula|last=Yoo|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160805213436/http://www.people.com/people/archive/article/0,,20103280,00.html|archive-date=August 5, 2016|url-status=dead|work=People}}</ref> a television news anchor 35 years his junior whom he first met when she interviewed him in March 1993.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.thedailybeast.com/dina-eastwood-opens-up-about-mrs-eastwood-and-company-and-life-with-clint|title=Dina Eastwood Opens Up About ''Mrs. Eastwood & Company'' and Life With Clint|first=Marlow|last=Stern|date=May 16, 2012|website=The Daily Beast}}</ref> It is not clear when exactly the two started seeing each other romantically. Eastwood took Ruiz to two high-profile golf tournaments in February 1995 without ever announcing that he and Fisher had broken up.<ref>{{cite web|last=Remington|first=Bob|date=March 8, 1995|url=https://www.newspapers.com/newspage/475393418|title=Love-styles of the rich & famous|work=Edmonton Journal|via=Newspapers.com}}</ref> In May, Eastwood admitted he was no longer living with Fisher and denied tabloid claims of an affair with [[Meryl Streep]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Stars deny affair on set of film|date=May 31, 1995|url=https://www.newspapers.com/newspage/1016041240|work=Gloucestershire Echo|via=Newspapers.com}}</ref> Ruiz confirmed her engagement to Eastwood on January 19, 1996, three weeks after it had leaked through the tabloids that they had taken out a marriage license.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://news.google.com/newspapers?id=J65HAAAAIBAJ&pg=4955%2C2798454|title=License, no date for Clint and Dina|work=Record-Journal|via=Google News Archive|date=January 21, 1996}}</ref> They married on March 31 at the [[North Las Vegas, Nevada|North Las Vegas]] home of casino magnate [[Steve Wynn]], just outside the [[Shadow Creek Golf Course]].<ref name=Kent>{{cite magazine|last=Kent|first=Peter|date=April 14, 1996|title=Clint Weds 'The Girl I've Been Waiting For' — And There's Not a Dry Eye in the House|url=https://www.newspapers.com/newspage/1278177569|work=The San Antonio Star|via=Newspapers.com}}</ref> The marriage was noted for the fact that it was only Eastwood's second legal union in spite of his many long-term romances over the decades. Eastwood said of his bride, "I'm proud to make this lady my wife. She's the one I've been waiting for."<ref name=Kent/> Ruiz commented, "The fact that I'm only the second woman he has married really touches me."<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.sfgate.com/entertainment/article/She-Makes-His-Day-Salinas-anchorwoman-Dina-Ruiz-2987378.php|title=She Makes His Day / Salinas anchorwoman Dina Ruiz gets used to role as Clint's wife|first=Sylvia|last=Rubin|work=San Francisco Chronicle|date=April 9, 1996}}</ref> The couple has one daughter, Morgan Eastwood (born December 12, 1996).{{sfn|Levy|2025|page=370}}

In 2001, Eastwood was rumored to be stepping out with jazz singer [[Diana Krall]], which their respective publicists shut down immediately.<ref name=Zwecker>{{cite news|title=All that Eastwood-Krall jazz may be on target|first=Bill|last=Zwecker|date=July 24, 2001|work= Chicago Sun-Times}}</ref> At that time, an unnamed close friend of Eastwood's told ''[[Chicago Sun-Times]]'' columnist Bill Zwecker that the actor and his wife had been spending less and less time together and that "I definitely think there has been some trouble ... but then, what marriage doesn't have its ups and downs?"<ref name=Zwecker/>

Ruiz made cameos in two of Eastwood's films: ''[[Blood Work (film)|Blood Work]]'' and ''[[True Crime (1999 film)|True Crime]]'' (in which Fisher even appeared). In the summer of 2012, Dina, Morgan and Francesca starred with the band [[Overtone (musical group)|Overtone]] in a reality show for the [[E!]] network titled ''[[Mrs. Eastwood & Company]]'', on which Clint appeared only occasionally.{{sfn|Levy|2025|page=455}} Also featured in the series was Dina's then-sister-in-law Jade Berti, granddaughter of comedy legend [[Groucho Marx]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.dailytribune.com/2012/05/18/mrs-eastwood-company-debuts|agency=Associated Press|title=''Mrs. Eastwood & Company'' debuts|date=May 18, 2012|work=Royal Oak Tribune}}</ref> By sheer coincidence, Marx's handprint square at [[Grauman's Chinese Theatre]] touches corners with Mr. Eastwood's; Berti viewed this as a sign of her relationship with Dina's brother, special effects coordinator Dominic Ruiz, being written "in stone and in the stars."<ref>{{cite episode|title=A Band of Eastwoods|series=Mrs. Eastwood & Company|network=E!|season=1|number=1|date=2012}}</ref>{{efn|Jade Berti divorced Dominic Ruiz in 2023.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://unicourt.com/case/ca-la23-marz-ruiz-jade-vs-ruiz-dominic-654636|title=Marx-Ruiz, Jade vs Ruiz, Dominic|date=March 3, 2023|publisher=UniCourt}}</ref>}} While promoting the show on ''[[Chelsea Lately]]'', Dina said jokingly: "I hope we're still married when this is over!"—a reference to the apparent trend that many marriages on reality TV end in divorce.<ref>{{cite episode|title=Episode #6.77|series=Chelsea Lately|credits=Interviewer: Chelsea Handler|network=E!|airdate=May 22, 2012}}</ref> The last episode aired on July 22, one month before Eastwood made a now-infamous speech at the [[Clint Eastwood at the 2012 Republican National Convention|2012 Republican National Convention]], which ex-partner Fisher openly criticized as a publicity stunt to promote his forthcoming movie ''[[Trouble with the Curve]]''.<ref name=Frances/> ''Mrs. Eastwood & Company'' did not return for a second season, and the following spring Dina checked herself into rehab for depression and anxiety.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.rte.ie/entertainment/2013/0425/444897-eastwoodc|title=Clint Eastwood's wife enters rehab|publisher=RTÉ|date=April 25, 2013}}</ref>

In August 2013, Dina Eastwood announced that she and her husband had been living separately for an undisclosed length of time.<ref name=Takeda>{{cite web|url=http://www.usmagazine.com/celebrity-news/news/clint-eastwood-wife-dina-eastwood-separate-after-nearly-17-years-of-marriage-2013298|date=August 29, 2013|title=Clint Eastwood, Wife Dina Eastwood Separate After Nearly 17 Years of Marriage|first=Allison|last=Takeda|work=Us Weekly}}</ref> An insider subsequently told ''Us Weekly'' that they actually split while her reality show was airing, and added, "Clint fell out of love with Dina a long time ago."<ref name=Takeda/> By fall, Eastwood's wife filed for divorce after she withdrew her request for legal separation, citing [[irreconcilable differences]]. She asked for full custody of their then-16-year-old daughter, Morgan, as well as spousal support, despite a [[prenuptial agreement]] waiving her right to the latter.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.tmz.com/2013/12/20/clint-eastwood-divorce-dina-separation-support-custody|title=Clint Eastwood Divorce -- No Way I'm Paying her Spousal Support!|publisher=TMZ|date=December 20, 2013}}</ref> Amid reports that Eastwood was trying to block her alimony request, Dina gave a televised interview on ''[[Bethenny (talk show)|Bethenny]]'', stating, "He's lovely, he hasn't done much. It's other people around him have done things that have blown me away."<ref>{{cite episode|title=Daytime Exclusive: Clint Eastwood's wife Dina Eastwood|series=Bethenny|credits=Interviewer: Bethenny Frankel|network=Fox|airdate=December 10, 2013}}</ref> The divorce was finalized on December 22, 2014.<ref name=Heger>{{cite web|url=https://radaronline.com/exclusives/2014/12/clint-eastwood-divorce-dina-eastwood-finalized|title=It's Over! Clint & Dina Eastwood Officially Divorced|date=December 23, 2014|first=Jen|last=Heger|work=Radar Online}}</ref> Eastwood, in typical fashion, had no comment at all, and no terms of financial settlement were revealed in the divorce decree.<ref name=Heger/>

that "I will miss her very much"; no further detail was provided in that initial statement.<ref name=Hayley/> Sandera's death certificate, obtained a week later by the ''[[New York Post]]'', listed her cause as [[arrhythmia]], with [[coronary artery disease]] outlined as an additional condition that led to death.<ref name=Hayley/>

As of August 2024, Eastwood was "doing OK" according to his son Scott.<ref>{{cite web|last=Rahbar|first=Sabba|date=August 14, 2024|url=https://www.eonline.com/news/1406146/clint-eastwoods-son-scott-shares-how-family-is-doing-after-death-of-christina-sandera|title=Clint Eastwood's Son Scott Shares How Family Is Doing After Death of Christina Sandera|publisher=E! Online}}</ref> In early September, his daughter Kimber reported that "the shock value is wearing off,"<ref>{{cite web|first1=Christina|last1=Dugan Ramirez|first2=Larry|last2=Fink|date=September 11, 2024|url=https://www.foxnews.com/entertainment/clint-eastwood-daughter-turned-family-tradition-wheel-fortune-career|title=Clint Eastwood's daughter turned family tradition into ''Wheel of Fortune'' career|publisher=Fox News}}</ref> and by the end of that month he already had a new girlfriend, according to investigative journalist [[Robert Eringer]].<ref>{{cite web|last=Eringer|first=Robert|date=October 2, 2024|url=https://roberteringer.substack.com/p/carmel-by-the-sea-bar-and-grill-revue|title=Carmel-by-the-Sea: Bar & Grill Revue|publisher=Substack}}</ref> The identity of Eastwood's latest girlfriend remains unknown.<ref name=Duncan/><ref>{{cite web|url=https://knewz.com/clint-eastwood-94-already-has-a-new-girlfriend-just-78-days-after-his-ex-christina-sandera-61-dropped-dead-of-heart-attack|title=Clint Eastwood, 94, 'Already Has A New Girlfriend' After Ex's Death|publisher=Knewz|date=October 8, 2024}}</ref>

== Further alleged offspring ==
[[File:Clint Eastwood and Roxanne Tunis.jpg|thumb|With Roxanne Tunis on the set of ''Rawhide'']]
Laurie Murray, Kimber Tunis, and Scott and Kathryn Reeves—as well as their respective mothers—are all [[lying by omission|omitted]] from the Eastwood episode of [[A&E Networks|A&E]]'s ''[[Biography (TV series)|Biography]]'' series, which first aired on October 5, 2003.<ref>{{cite news|title=Behind the Scenes with Clint|newspaper=The Dallas Morning News|date=October 4, 2003|url=https://www.newslibrary.com/newspapers/news/0FDFD33A8EA4BCA8|via=NewsLibrary|url-access=registration}}</ref> According to McGilligan, "The people who know Clint best suspect there are other families in his closet."{{sfn|McGilligan|2002|page=501}} The UK edition of ''Clint: The Life and Legend'' (1999) was the first publication to report Laurie's existence, although her name was not revealed, and she was not acknowledged by any media outlet until she identified herself to photographers at the December 2018 premiere of ''[[The Mule (2018 film)|The Mule]]''.<ref>{{cite news|last=Mahjouri|first=Shakiel|url=https://etcanada.com/news/396503/clint-eastwood-brings-his-secret-daughter-to-the-mule-premiere|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181213090324/https://etcanada.com/news/396503/clint-eastwood-brings-his-secret-daughter-to-the-mule-premiere|url-status=dead|archive-date=December 13, 2018|title=Clint Eastwood Brings His 'Secret Daughter' to ''The Mule'' Premiere|work=Entertainment Tonight Canada|date=December 13, 2018}}</ref>

Some sources, including a now-defunct website launched in 2006 by his cousin Steve, cite another child named Lesly (born February 13, 1959) by Rosina Mary Glen.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.seastwood.com/backup310/Eastwood/clintchildren.asp|title=Relationships & Offspring: An Attempt to Clarify|first=Steve|last=Eastwood|publisher=seastwood.com|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120521085549/http://www.seastwood.com/backup310/Eastwood/clintchildren.asp|archive-date=May 21, 2012|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://filmstarfacts.com/2016/10/05/know-garson-darnell-eastwood-boyle|title=Did you know?|first=Alan|last=Royle|publisher=filmstarfacts.com|date=October 5, 2016}}</ref>

Publicly, Eastwood has been [[Silent treatment|silent]] on claims of other offspring.{{efn|In an unpublicized 2011 court filing, Eastwood did deny fathering Eric James Chisum, a 48-year-old transient who had repeatedly claimed to be his son.<ref>{{cite web|first=Andy|last=Stiny|date=May 1, 2013|work=Santa Cruz Sentinel|url=https://www.santacruzsentinel.com/2013/05/01/man-claiming-to-be-clint-eastwoods-son-caused-actor-to-get-restraining-order-in-2011|title=Man claiming to be Clint Eastwood's son caused actor to get restraining order in 2011}}</ref>}} "We don't know how many children Clint has had with how many women," McGilligan stated on-camera in the 2012 French documentary ''L'album secret de Clint Eastwood''.<ref name=auto/> "One was when he was still in high school [...] I heard of other possibilities."<ref name=auto/> ''[[Playboy]]'' notes that "the number is unconfirmed and Eastwood is reticent about the issue."<ref name=Playboy/>

When [[Steve Kroft]] asked Eastwood how many children he has during a 1997 ''[[60 Minutes]]'' interview, Eastwood replied, without further elaboration, "I have a few."<ref name=Kroft>{{cite episode|title=Clint Eastwood|series=60 Minutes|credits=Interviewer: Steve Kroft|network=CBS|airdate=November 16, 1997}}</ref> According to Kroft, "The subject brought the temperature in the room down to about 40 degrees. He just stared at me for about 30 seconds [...] Obviously, it was not a subject he wanted to talk about."<ref name=Kroft/><ref>{{cite news|title=Eastwood turns icy on ''60 Minutes''|first1=Marilyn|last1=Beck|first2=Stacy Jenel|last2=Smith|date=November 14, 1997|work=Fremont Tribune|url=https://www.newspapers.com/newspage/524454663|via=Newspapers.com}}</ref>

Eastwood has been known to terminate conversations if his children are mentioned. Such was the case with the ''[[Boston Herald]]''{{'}}s Stephen Schaefer, who in 2019 recalled: "He sits, we talk and then I ask about his [number of] kids. Without saying another word, he stands and leaves. Interview abruptly over."<ref>{{cite web|title=Hollywood & Mine: Forgiveness? Sondra Locke, Clint & ''The Mule''|first=Stephen|last=Schaefer|date=January 24, 2019|work=Boston Herald|url=https://www.bostonherald.com/2019/01/24/hollywood-mine-forgiveness-sondra-locke-clint-the-mule}}</ref> Indeed, Eastwood's [[modus operandi]] is to communicate only by gesture, inference, and what isn't said or done.{{sfn|Locke|1997|pages=218, 234–236}}{{sfn|Levy|2025|pages=298, 349, 495}} "If he doesn't want to answer a question," said Frances Fisher in 2026, "he'll just look at you."<ref >{{cite web|last=Fisher|first=Frances|interviewer=Steve Kmetko|title=Still Here Hollywood|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=D8L52Q8nPCs|format=Podcast|date=March 23, 2026|time=1:44}}</ref>
